verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own workflow lets a person describe work ('Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') to create an intention/task that an agent then claims and executes (foreloop-docs-4, foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-37), and PRs can be linked back to that intention (foreloop-docs-26). However, there is no evidence of importing or assigning from an existing external issue/ticket system (e.g., GitHub Issues, Jira, Linear) — the flow is centered on Foreloop's native intentions/tasks, not pre-existing tickets. Missing for 10: explicit integration to pull/assign tasks from external issue trackers, and confirmation that an agent can be pointed at an already-existing ticket rather than a newly authored intention.
